improvements.rationale: Search engines display meta descriptions in results, directly influencing click-through rates. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags control how the page appears when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. These tags reinforce key value props (Claude-powered, instant answers, voice chat, free trial) without inventing claims, and maintain the professional tone aligned with the brand.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant), who it's for (trade and business professionals), and the key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, professional support). The subheading removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no commitment, which drives conversions by lowering the barrier to entry. The language is confident and direct without making unverified claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Memberships start from just US$2 per day, with flexible monthly or annual billing options—annual plans save you 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock voice chat, an unlimited workspace, and professional-grade assistance whenever you need it.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition, pricing, and added member benefits, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and encourages conversion by framing membership as accessible and valuable.
